Name: Olive & Ember. Style: Neapolitan pizza, fresh pasta and Italian small plates. Town: Nottingham.
Hours: Sunday: 12 noon till 8pm. Tuesday to Saturday: lunch 12 noon till 2:30pm, dinner 5:30pm till 10pm. Closed Mondays.
Table bookings: yes, up to 10 by phone; areas Inside, Terrace. Walk-ins: welcome.
Click and collect: yes, 20 minutes' notice. Delivery: no.

Deposits: per person for parties of 7 or more. Please give 48 hours' notice to cancel or change. Deposits are refunded with 48 hours' notice. A discretionary 12.5% service charge is added for tables of six or more.

Children: Children are very welcome, with highchairs and a kids’ menu. Dogs: outside only. Access: Step-free entrance, level floor throughout the ground floor, and an accessible toilet. Parking: No car park of our own; the nearest multi-storey is about five minutes’ walk.

Dress code: No dress code. Corkage: We don’t allow bring your own. Cakes: You’re welcome to bring a birthday cake; there’s no cakeage charge. Vouchers: Gift vouchers are available in the restaurant. Dietary: Plenty of vegetarian dishes, several vegan, and gluten-free pizza bases.

Menu: Starters: Garlic bread, Bruschetta, Arancini; Pizzas: Margherita, Diavola, Funghi, Vegan Verdure; Pasta: Spaghetti Carbonara, Penne Arrabbiata, Lasagne, Trofie al Pesto; Desserts: Tiramisu, Panna cotta, Affogato; Soft drinks: San Pellegrino, Coca-Cola.
